bug_semantics: Kustomize helm-chart inflation builds a single shell command `helm pull --untar --untardir <quoted> --version <quoted> --repo <quoted> <depName>` and runs it through Renovate exec, which force-sets shell:true. depName comes from user-controlled kustomization.yaml helmCharts[].name (and a matching Helm index.yaml entry) and is not passed through shlex quote. Metacharacters in the chart name (PoC: `example || kill 1; echo`) execute as the Renovate host user. After a later helper extract, the same unquoted token is the depName argument of helmRepositoryArgs in lib/modules/manager/kustomize/artifacts.ts. CWE-77. npm renovate >= 39.218.0 and < 40.33.0.
flaw_origin: First write is reconstructable PR #34277 member bce4f50dbb6b54cf4fce5d8463bd8268c4589bf5 (Implement helm chart inflation in kustomize manager) adding lib/modules/manager/kustomize/artifacts.ts with `... --repo ${quote(registryUrl)} ${dependency.depName}` at line 109. Immediate parent c0761652c042e31124a2f4abbfe6870241a8cdfe has no artifacts.ts and no kustomize helm pull. Member 3f057936e99a43b1dc51f071dc6dc226903e1a40 only refactored that token into helmRepositoryArgs (`return `--repo ${quote(repository)} ${depName}`;`) without quoting. GitHub squash-merge cc08c6e98f19e6258c5d3180c70c98e1be0b0d37 is the main landing vehicle (feat #34277, 2025-03-26), not the first-write BIC. VulnCheck/CVE-2026-76229 mis-tags cc08c6e as a patch; first-party GHSA-xv56-3wq5-9997 correctly cites it as the introduction. Human author Micke Lisinge.
